---- MODULE W4Od3m3p3t2 ----
EXTENDS FiniteSets, Naturals
CONSTANTS Slots, NodesA, NodesB, NONE
VARIABLES ledgerA, ledgerB, leaderA, leaderB
vars == <<ledgerA, ledgerB, leaderA, leaderB>>

Init ==
  /\ ledgerA = {}
  /\ ledgerB = {}
  /\ leaderA = NONE
  /\ leaderB = NONE

ElectA == leaderA = NONE /\ \E n \in NodesA: leaderA' = n /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerA, ledgerB, leaderB>>
ElectB == leaderB = NONE /\ \E n \in NodesB: leaderB' = n /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerA, ledgerB, leaderA>>
FailA  == leaderA # NONE /\ leaderA' = NONE /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerA, ledgerB, leaderB>>
FailB  == leaderB # NONE /\ leaderB' = NONE /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerA, ledgerB, leaderA>>

ClaimA == \E s \in Slots:
            /\ leaderA # NONE
            /\ s \notin ledgerA
            /\ s \notin ledgerB
            /\ ledgerA' = ledgerA \cup {s}
            /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerB, leaderA, leaderB>>
ClaimB == \E s \in Slots:
            /\ leaderB # NONE
            /\ s \notin ledgerB
            /\ s \notin ledgerA
            /\ ledgerB' = ledgerB \cup {s}
            /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerA, leaderA, leaderB>>

ReleaseA == \E s \in ledgerA: ledgerA' = ledgerA \ {s} /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerB, leaderA, leaderB>>
ReleaseB == \E s \in ledgerB: ledgerB' = ledgerB \ {s} /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerA, leaderA, leaderB>>

Next == ElectA \/ ElectB \/ FailA \/ FailB \/ ClaimA \/ ClaimB \/ ReleaseA \/ ReleaseB
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAllocation == ledgerA \cap ledgerB = {}
====
nl:
An interbank settlement system runs two independent settlement instances, A and B, that draw from one shared pool of settlement slots. Each instance is a small cluster of nodes that elects a single leader; only the current leader of an instance may claim slots on that instance's behalf. Either instance's leader may fail at any moment, clearing the leadership so a surviving node must be elected before claiming resumes. When a leader claims a slot it records that slot in its instance's ledger, but only if the slot is held by neither instance. A leader may later release a slot it holds, returning it to the shared pool. Because both instances draw from the same pool, the danger is that the same settlement slot ends up recorded as allocated by both instances at once. The claim guard exists precisely to prevent that race across the shared pool.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No settlement slot is ever recorded in both instance A's ledger and instance B's ledger at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od18m5p0t3 ----
EXTENDS FiniteSets, Naturals
CONSTANTS Users, Controllers, Quorum, NONE
VARIABLES requesting, ballot, holds, actuator
vars == <<requesting, ballot, holds, actuator>>

Init ==
  /\ requesting = {}
  /\ ballot = [u \in Users |-> {}]
  /\ holds = [u \in Users |-> FALSE]
  /\ actuator = "Locked"

Request(u) ==
  /\ u \notin requesting
  /\ ~holds[u]
  /\ requesting' = requesting \cup {u}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, holds, actuator>>

CastVote(c, u) ==
  /\ u \in requesting
  /\ c \notin ballot[u]
  /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![u] = ballot[u] \cup {c}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<requesting, holds, actuator>>

Grant(u) ==
  /\ u \in requesting
  /\ Cardinality(ballot[u]) >= Quorum
  /\ \A o \in Users: ~holds[o]
  /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![u] = TRUE]
  /\ actuator' = "Unlocked"
  /\ requesting' = requesting \ {u}
  /\ UNCHANGED ballot

Release(u) ==
  /\ holds[u]
  /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![u] = FALSE]
  /\ actuator' = "Locked"
  /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![u] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED requesting

Next ==
  \/ \E u \in Users: Request(u)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, u \in Users: CastVote(c, u)
  \/ \E u \in Users: Grant(u)
  \/ \E u \in Users: Release(u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OneLockAtMost == \A u \in Users: holds[u] => (\A o \in Users \ {u}: ~holds[o])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Users = {u1, u2}
  Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
  Quorum = 2
  NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneLockAtMost
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network is governed by three controllers that jointly decide who may operate the single shared lock actuator. A resident requests access, after which each controller may independently cast a vote in favor of that request; controllers can be slow to respond but never fail outright, so votes arrive in any order and at any time. A request is granted only once at least a quorum of two controllers have voted for it and no resident currently holds the lock; granting marks that resident as holding the lock and physically unlocks the actuator. The resident later releases the lock, which relocks the actuator and clears the tally of votes for the next round. Because the actuator is a single physical mechanism, the whole point of the quorum protocol is to make sure two residents are never granted the lock at the same time. The no-holder guard on granting is what enforces that.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one resident holds the door lock at any time; if one resident holds it, no other resident does.

---- MODULE W4Od2m3p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, NONE
VARIABLES leader, occupant, charging, queue
vars == <<leader, occupant, charging, queue>>

Init ==
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ occupant = NONE
  /\ charging = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]
  /\ queue = {}

Elect == leader = NONE /\ \E r \in Robots: leader' = r /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, charging, queue>>
FailLeader == leader # NONE /\ leader' = NONE /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, charging, queue>>

Request(r) ==
  /\ r \notin queue
  /\ ~charging[r]
  /\ queue' = queue \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, occupant, charging>>

Grant(r) ==
  /\ leader # NONE
  /\ r \in queue
  /\ occupant = NONE
  /\ occupant' = r
  /\ charging' = [charging EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
  /\ queue' = queue \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED leader

AdminGrant(r) ==
  /\ r \in queue
  /\ occupant = NONE
  /\ occupant' = r
  /\ charging' = [charging EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
  /\ queue' = queue \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED leader

Release(r) ==
  /\ occupant = r
  /\ charging[r]
  /\ occupant' = NONE
  /\ charging' = [charging EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, queue>>

Next ==
  \/ Elect \/ FailLeader
  \/ \E r \in Robots: Request(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots: Grant(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots: AdminGrant(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots: Release(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ExclusiveBay == \A r \in Robots: charging[r] => occupant = r
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Robots = {r1, r2, r3}
  NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ExclusiveBay
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet shares a single charging bay that only one robot may occupy at a time. The robots elect a leader that normally coordinates who charges next; if the leader fails, its role is cleared and a new leader must be elected before ordinary grants resume. A robot that wants to charge joins a request queue. The leader grants the bay to a queued robot only when the bay is empty, which marks that robot as the bay's occupant and switches its charging flag on. A privileged admin override exists that can grant the bay to a queued robot directly without going through the leader, but the override still respects that the bay must be empty first. When a robot finishes it releases the bay, clearing the occupant and its charging flag. The safety concern is that the single charging bay must never show two robots drawing power at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every robot whose charging flag is on must be the sole recorded occupant of the bay, so two robots can never charge simultaneously.

VARIABLES leader, alive, printing, printer

Init ==
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ alive = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
  /\ printing = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
  /\ printer = NONE

Elect ==
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ \E n \in Nodes: alive[n] /\ leader' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, printing, printer>>

Crash(n) ==

  /\ ~printing[n]
  /\ Cardinality({m \in Nodes: alive[m]}) > 1
  /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
  /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN NONE ELSE leader
  /\ UNCHANGED <<printing, printer>>

StartPrint(n) ==
  /\ leader # NONE
  /\ alive[n]
  /\ printer = NONE
  /\ printer' = n
  /\ printing' = [printing EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

FinishPrint(n) ==
  /\ printer = n
  /\ printing[n]
  /\ printer' = NONE
  /\ printing' = [printing EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

Next ==
  \/ Elect
  \/ \E n \in Nodes: Crash(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes: StartPrint(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes: FinishPrint(n)

CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
  NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SingleActivePrinter
nl:
A print-shop job spooler runs on a small cluster of nodes that share one physical printer. The nodes elect a leader that authorizes which node may start a print job; only a live node can be elected. Any node may crash silently at any time, simply going offline without warning, and if the crashed node was the leader the leadership is cleared so a survivor must be elected before new jobs start. A node starts printing only when a leader exists, the node is alive, and the printer is idle; this claims the printer and marks that node as actively printing. When the node finishes, it frees the printer and clears its printing mark. Because there is exactly one printer, the spooler must guarantee that no two nodes are ever mid-print at the same time, even across leader failover and silent crashes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one node is actively printing at any moment.

---- MODULE W4Od4m8p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Stations, MaxVersion, NONE
VARIABLES coarse, fine, version, staged
vars == <<coarse, fine, version, staged>>

Init ==
  /\ coarse = NONE
  /\ fine = NONE
  /\ version = 0
  /\ staged = [s \in Stations |-> NONE]

AcquireCoarse(s) ==
  /\ coarse = NONE
  /\ coarse' = s
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, version, staged>>

AcquireFine(s) ==
  /\ coarse = s
  /\ fine = NONE
  /\ fine' = s
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, version, staged>>

Read(s) ==
  /\ fine = s
  /\ staged[s] = NONE
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![s] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, version>>

Commit(s) ==
  /\ fine = s
  /\ staged[s] # NONE
  /\ version < MaxVersion
  /\ version' = staged[s] + 1
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseFine(s) ==
  /\ fine = s
  /\ staged[s] = NONE
  /\ fine' = NONE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, version, staged>>

ReleaseCoarse(s) ==
  /\ coarse = s
  /\ fine # s
  /\ coarse' = NONE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, version, staged>>

AdminReset ==
  /\ coarse' = NONE
  /\ fine' = NONE
  /\ staged' = [s \in Stations |-> NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED version

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Stations: AcquireCoarse(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations: AcquireFine(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations: Read(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations: Commit(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations: ReleaseFine(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations: ReleaseCoarse(s)
  \/ AdminReset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleWrite == \A s \in Stations: (fine = s /\ staged[s] # NONE) => staged[s] = version
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Stations = {w1, w2}
  MaxVersion = 3
  NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleWrite
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line lets multiple wash stations update one shared wash-configuration record, whose current value is tracked by a version number. To write safely a station must acquire two nested locks in order: first a coarse line-wide lock, then a fine record lock, and it may only take the fine lock if it already holds the coarse lock. Holding the fine lock, the station reads the record by snapshotting the current version, then commits by writing a new version derived from its snapshot and clearing the snapshot. It then releases the fine lock and later the coarse lock. A privileged admin override can reset both locks and discard all snapshots at once for recovery, without touching the committed record value. The hazard being prevented is a lost update: a station committing on top of a snapshot that no longer reflects the record's current version. Correct hierarchical locking guarantees that while a station holds the fine lock its snapshot stays current.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a station holds the fine record lock and has an outstanding snapshot, that snapshot equals the record's current version, so no station ever writes based on a stale read.

---- MODULE W4Od2m2p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, Capacity, NONE
VARIABLES phase, vote, load, proposal
vars == <<phase, vote, load, proposal>>

Init ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ vote = [r \in Robots |-> "none"]
  /\ load = 0
  /\ proposal = 0

Propose(amt) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ proposal' = amt
  /\ vote' = [r \in Robots |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED load

CastVote(r, v) ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ vote[r] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![r] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, load, proposal>>

Commit ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \A r \in Robots: vote[r] = "yes"
  /\ load + proposal <= Capacity
  /\ load' = load + proposal
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ proposal' = 0
  /\ vote' = [r \in Robots |-> "none"]

Abort ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ (\E r \in Robots: vote[r] = "no") \/ (load + proposal > Capacity)
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ proposal' = 0
  /\ vote' = [r \in Robots |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED load

Next ==
  \/ \E amt \in 1..2: Propose(amt)
  \/ \E r \in Robots, v \in {"yes", "no"}: CastVote(r, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected == load <= Capacity
====

CONSTANTS
  Robots = {r1, r2}
  Capacity = 3
  NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet loads items onto one shared shelf whose total load must never exceed a fixed capacity. Batches of new load are committed using two-phase commit across the participating robots. A coordinator proposes a batch of a given size, moving the protocol into a voting phase and resetting every robot's vote. Each robot then casts a yes or no vote; robots may be slow, casting their votes in any order and at any time, but they never fail to vote eventually. The batch commits only if every robot voted yes and the shelf's current load plus the proposed amount still fits within capacity, in which case the load increases and the protocol returns to idle. If any robot votes no, or the batch would overflow the shelf, the transaction aborts and the load is unchanged. The essential safety guarantee is that the shelf's load is never driven above its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shelf's committed load never exceeds the fixed capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od10m2p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS TotalTrains, NONE
VARIABLES occ, phase, vote, move
vars == <<occ, phase, vote, move>>

Blocks == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
Total(o) == o["b1"] + o["b2"] + o["b3"]

Init ==
  /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> IF b = "b1" THEN TotalTrains ELSE 0]
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ vote = [c \in Controllers |-> "none"]
  /\ move = <<"b1", "b1">>

Propose(src, dst) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ src # dst
  /\ occ[src] > 0
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ move' = <<src, dst>>
  /\ vote' = [c \in Controllers |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED occ

CastVote(c, v) ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ vote[c] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![c] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, phase, move>>

Commit ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \A c \in Controllers: vote[c] = "yes"
  /\ occ[move[1]] > 0
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![move[1]] = @ - 1, ![move[2]] = @ + 1]
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, move>>

Abort ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \E c \in Controllers: vote[c] = "no"
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, vote, move>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s, d \in Blocks: Propose(s, d)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, v \in {"yes", "no"}: CastVote(c, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TrainsConserved == Total(occ) = TotalTrains
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  TotalTrains = 2
  NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TrainsConserved
nl:
A subway signalling block system tracks how many trains occupy each of three track blocks; all trains start in the first block. Trains are handed from one block to an adjacent one using two-phase commit across two signalling controllers, so that a movement is agreed by both before it takes effect. A move is proposed from a source block that currently holds at least one train to a different destination block, entering a voting phase and resetting both controllers' votes. Each controller then votes yes or no, and controllers may be slow, voting in any order at any time, but they do not fail. The move commits only if both controllers voted yes and the source still holds a train, at which point exactly one train leaves the source and appears in the destination. A no vote aborts the move with no change. Trains are only ever relocated, never created or destroyed, so the total number of trains across all blocks must stay constant.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of trains summed over all blocks always equals the fixed initial train count.

---- MODULE W4Od16m2p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Scripts, Checkers, MaxStock, NONE
VARIABLES phase, vote, dispensing, stock
vars == <<phase, vote, dispensing, stock>>

Init ==
  /\ phase = [s \in Scripts |-> "idle"]
  /\ vote = [s \in Scripts |-> [c \in Checkers |-> "none"]]
  /\ dispensing = [s \in Scripts |-> FALSE]
  /\ stock = 1

Propose(s) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "idle"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "voting"]
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![s] = [c \in Checkers |-> "none"]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dispensing, stock>>

CastVote(s, c, v) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "voting"
  /\ vote[s][c] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![s][c] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, dispensing, stock>>

BeginDispense(s) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "voting"
  /\ \A c \in Checkers: vote[s][c] = "yes"
  /\ \A o \in Scripts: ~dispensing[o]
  /\ stock > 0
  /\ dispensing' = [dispensing EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "active"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, stock>>

Finish(s) ==
  /\ dispensing[s]
  /\ dispensing' = [dispensing EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
  /\ stock' = stock - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED vote

Abort(s) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "voting"
  /\ \E c \in Checkers: vote[s][c] = "no"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, dispensing, stock>>

Refill ==
  /\ stock < MaxStock
  /\ stock' = stock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, dispensing>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Scripts: Propose(s)
  \/ \E s \in Scripts, c \in Checkers, v \in {"yes", "no"}: CastVote(s, c, v)
  \/ \E s \in Scripts: BeginDispense(s)
  \/ \E s \in Scripts: Finish(s)
  \/ \E s \in Scripts: Abort(s)
  \/ Refill

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OneDispenseAtATime ==
  \A s \in Scripts: dispensing[s] => (\A o \in Scripts \ {s}: ~dispensing[o])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Scripts = {p1, p2}
  Checkers = {ck1, ck2}
  MaxStock = 2
  NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneDispenseAtATime
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser fills prescriptions through a single dispensing mechanism that can physically handle only one prescription at a time. Before a prescription is dispensed, two independent safety checkers must both approve it using a two-phase commit: the prescription enters a voting phase and each checker casts a yes or no vote. Dispensing of a prescription begins only when both checkers voted yes, no other prescription is currently being dispensed, and there is dose stock on hand; this marks the prescription active on the mechanism. When dispensing finishes, the prescription returns to idle and one unit of stock is consumed. The available dose stock is not fixed: it changes at runtime as the mechanism is refilled up to a maximum. The overriding safety requirement is that the single mechanism never dispenses two prescriptions concurrently, regardless of stock changes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one prescription is being dispensed at any instant.

---- MODULE W4Od1m6p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Writers, MaxClock, MaxVersion, NONE
VARIABLES clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, version, staged
vars == <<clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, version, staged>>

Init ==
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ leaseOwner = NONE
  /\ leaseExp = 0
  /\ version = 0
  /\ staged = [w \in Writers |-> NONE]

Acquire(w) ==
  /\ leaseOwner = NONE
  /\ leaseOwner' = w
  /\ leaseExp' = clock + 2
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, version, staged>>

Read(w) ==
  /\ leaseOwner = w
  /\ clock < leaseExp
  /\ staged[w] = NONE
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, version>>

Commit(w) ==
  /\ leaseOwner = w
  /\ clock < leaseExp
  /\ staged[w] # NONE
  /\ version < MaxVersion
  /\ version' = staged[w] + 1
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp>>

Discard(w) ==
  /\ staged[w] # NONE
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, version>>

Release(w) ==
  /\ leaseOwner = w
  /\ staged[w] = NONE
  /\ leaseOwner' = NONE
  /\ leaseExp' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, version, staged>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxClock
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ IF leaseOwner # NONE /\ clock + 1 >= leaseExp
       THEN /\ leaseOwner' = NONE

A proposal opens a new round, moving the line into a voting phase and clearing every station's vote. Stations send vote messages tagged with the round they were voting in, and because the network reorders and delays messages, these votes arrive in an unordered inbox in any order. The coordinator applies a vote only if it is fresh, meaning its tagged round equals the current round and the station has not yet voted this round; it stamps the recorded vote with that round. Any vote message whose tag does not match the current round is stale and is simply dropped without being counted. The program commits when all stations have voted yes and aborts if any voted no. The key requirement is that no stale or unauthorized vote from an old round ever influences the current transaction: every counted vote must belong to the round currently in progress.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every recorded station vote carries the current round number, so no stale vote from a previous round is ever counted in the transaction.
